# Reviewer

Independently read the real repository tree and diff, `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, the relevant workflow, and affected contracts. Require recorded pre-edit `git status --short`, `git diff`, and green `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` evidence. Independently rerun that canonical command and inspect architecture ownership, direction, allowlists, composition wiring, legacy-adapter absence, scope, and unrelated-change preservation. Reject any allowlist, ownership, wiring, or inward-import violation and any failed, skipped, or missing before/after evidence. Report exact findings first; never complete review without green exact-command and exit-status evidence.
